al.t1: The immigrant population in Mexican territory increased 123% according to data from the International Organization for Migration (IOM). Nuevo Leon, bordering the United States, receives a constant flow of migrants in their eagerness to reach that country.
al.t2: Alianza Acércate is a solidarity network of civil organizations that assists migrants in Nuevo Leon in order to promote orderly and safe migration. In this way, it addresses the human rights violations and lack of inclusion that migrants experience.
al.t3: The graphic identity is based on diverse organic forms that represent the plurality that exists in the migratory effect and how these differences enrich us. The interaction of these elements is a metaphor of how when we come into contact with people who are different from us we are transformed and develop empathy.
al.t4: This identity shows the benefits that migration can have if it is managed in an orderly and safe manner.
al.t5: The color palette conveys the brand values: trust, closeness, stability, diversity, enthusiasm and vitality.
al.t8: Influence the change of mentality of NL people towards migrants
